title: TB3 Fragment Convergence, Collision & Serial Registry-Handoff Readiness
purpose: Converge the independently qualified TB03A and TB03B bounded fragment packages mechanically and adversarially without mutating the central testbank registry or creating new scientific test claims.

central_registry_baseline.authority: ANIMO-TB01 seed registry carried unchanged by ANIMO-TB02

nh4_no3.tb03a: ATB-SPC-004 remains CANDIDATE because a dedicated reusable executable NH4/NO3 ownership adapter is still pending.
nh4_no3.tb03b: ATB-CONS-004 is a qualified conservation aggregation contract requiring NH4-N and NO3-N ledgers to remain species-resolved before elemental-N aggregation.
nh4_no3.decision: NO_CONTRADICTION_AND_NO_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION: the conservation contract does not satisfy the missing executable species-ownership adapter obligation.

species_and_conservation.decision: COMPLEMENTARY_BOUNDED_SCOPES: TB03A establishes selected atomic/species ownership contracts; TB03B establishes typed transaction and control-volume contracts. Neither package establishes whole-network C/N/P correctness or whole-model conservation.

candidate_and_gap_preservation.decision: MANDATORY: ATB-SPC-004 through ATB-SPC-006 must remain CANDIDATE and ATB-SPC-007 must remain GAP in any later consolidation unless a separate workunit supplies new qualifying evidence.

alternative_hypotheses_checked: two green fragment packages can still collide on stable ATB identifiers
dependencies can resolve inside one sibling branch but fail after convergence
a qualified conservation contract can be misread as satisfying an unqualified species-ownership adapter
candidate or GAP entries can be accidentally promoted by aggregation
local control-volume closure can be overgeneralized to whole-model conservation
synthetic or structural evidence can be misread as TCD admission or historical B2
a convergence workunit can accidentally become the forbidden central-registry writer
disposition: fail closed on any cross-fragment or central-registry test-id collision
require dependency closure against the union of the central registry and both exact fragment identities
treat TB03B NH4/NO3 aggregation as complementary to, not a replacement for, the pending TB03A ownership adapter
create no new ATB test entries and perform no registry write
